verdict: Second row of the decision table, and only barely. One of the three runs moves: HiTab S2 +.0205 (54:37, p=.093), +.0279 given OSC=1 (54:35, p=.056). AIT-QA is flat and turns NEGATIVE conditionally, HiTab S3c is zero. Not established.
